chabauty_kim_dimension_bound.instructions: For the affine hyperbolic curve P^1 \ {0, 1, infty} with bad reduction set S = {2, 3}, does the depth-2 unipotent Albanese variety Selmer dimension satisfy dim H^1_f(G_{Q, S}, U_2) < dim(U_2), providing non-trivial Chabauty-Kim p-adic analytic functions cutting out finite S-integral points?

criteria.effective_finiteness: Yes, for S = {2, 3}, the depth-2 Selmer variety has strictly smaller dimension than the unipotent group, yielding effective non-trivial analytic obstructions.
criteria.dimension_tie: Dimension tie: depth-2 is critical and requires depth-3 or higher unipotent quotients.
criteria.uncontrolled_growth: No, Selmer dimension grows too rapidly even for S = {2, 3}.

kraus_10k_frontier_density.instructions: For prime exponents p in [6501, 10000], is the auxiliary prime density q = 2kp + 1 with k <= 50 sufficient to guarantee 100% elimination rate against both 72a1 and 144a1 without encountering unresolvable trace collisions?

criteria.true: Yes, empirical and Chebotarev density guarantees full elimination for all primes in this range.
criteria.false: No, trace collisions or lack of primes q = 2kp + 1 with k <= 50 obstructs full elimination.
